focus: Q4 continuity save/resume routing; Q5 goal system and the 4,000-character durable-slice budget
answeredQuestions: Does continuity save and resume (generate-context.js, /speckit:save, /speckit:resume) route content where the v4.0.0.13, v4.0.0.14 and v4.0.1.0 notes say it does?
Does the goal system shipped in v4.0.0.2 (goal.md template, goal.cjs, the 4,000-character slice budget) behave as its docs say, and where is the budget enforced?

graphEvents.label: check-goal --all ignores findings in its exit code
Past-4,000 does not fail at bind or packet
packet emits chat_slice when over budget
packet resolves paths against the caller directory
Continuity save, handoff and decision routing match the v4.0.0.13/14 and v4.0.1.0 notes

label: check-goal.cjs --all returns success when it has findings: the corpus branch returns report.errors.length === 0 ? 0 : 2 and never reads report.findings, while per-packet mode returns 1 on a failed check. The run printed 472 missing-binding-row, 121 placeholder and 40 criteria-count findings, and exited 2 only because of one broken-fence read error.

The check-goal corpus scan excludes only z_archive, so frozen review-lineage baselines under specs/**/review/lineages/**/containment/baseline and review-archive are counted as active goals; 472 missing-binding-row findings are dominated by duplicate copies.

The v4.0.0.2 note says a goal past 4,000 characters fails, but goal.cjs bind only warns and still returns STATUS=OK, and goal.cjs packet exits 0 while printing chat_slice; the only hard failure is the per-packet check-goal exit 1. The send rule is prose in AGENTS.md and renderResendReminderText, not a writer refusal.
verify: Bind a packet whose durable slice exceeds 4000 characters and inspect STATUS and the warning; run goal.cjs packet and inspect the exit code.

label: goal.cjs packet prints chat_slice unconditionally after packet_budget, with no branch on budgetState, so an over-budget packet still yields a paste-ready slice. Omitting chat_slice or exiting 2 when packet_budget=over would make the safe path the only path.
verify: Run goal.cjs packet against an over-budget packet and check whether chat_slice is present and the exit status is 0.

label: goal.cjs packet defaults workspace to process.cwd() and is in actionsWithoutScope, so the MISSING_WORKSPACE guard is skipped; running the documented send-rule command from a subdirectory resolves the repo-relative packet path against that subdirectory and returns PACKET_GOAL_NOT_FOUND unless --workspace is passed.
verify: From specs/, run node ../.skilled/hooks/goal/bin/goal.cjs packet system-speckit/047-v4-release-line-research/001-spec-kit-core, then rerun with --workspace ..
